changelog: Added QR Scanner feature to read price tag QR codes and send data directly to PC (for branches without a physical scanner device).
Scanner customer entry now fills Name, Short, Township and Phone on the PC automatically, handles the 'name already exists' prompt, and ends with Cancel / Re-enter / Save.
Added Clinic tab with doctor fee tracking.
Added Shop Mode: choose any mix of Glasses, Contact Lens, Watches & Service and Clinic. Navigation and Summary now show only what you enable.
Redesigned Summary with Total Cash Income, Doctor Fee, Cash Balance and Monthly Total. Glasses and Watches are now clearly separated.
Monthly Statement and Remittance now include Clinic income and Doctor fee.
Lens Stock History now belongs to Glasses only.
Watch Daily Ground: tap the clipboard button to copy the report with your shop name and open the preview dialog. Added a new button to add watch brands.

Added Theme Gallery: customize colors, table lines, corner radius, fonts, spacing and background image for Summary, Expenses, Daily Ground and Monthly Statement images. Themes can be shared and imported as XML.
Settings reorganized into a compact menu. Backup, restore and clear old backups moved into Manage offline database.
Fixed a minor bug in the Expenses section.
Optimized and smoothed out the Cloud Sync functionality.
Minor bug fixes and performance improvements.
